title: Relationships through adversity
learning_outcomes: Explain stress and caregiving in the context of relationships through adversity.
Compare and distinguish practical support in the context of relationships through adversity.
Apply autonomy in the context of relationships through adversity.
Evaluate and justify decisions about specialist assistance in the context of relationships through adversity.

lessons.title: Stress and caregiving
lessons.outcome: Explain stress and caregiving in the context of relationships through adversity.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving stress and caregiving; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to family transition plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain stress and caregiving from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of stress and caregiving; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Practical support
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish practical support in the context of relationships through adversity.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving practical support; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to family transition plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain practical support from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of practical support; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Autonomy
lessons.outcome: Apply autonomy in the context of relationships through adversity.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving autonomy; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to family transition plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain autonomy from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of autonomy; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Specialist assistance
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about specialist assistance in the context of relationships through adversity.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving specialist assistance; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to family transition plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain specialist assistance from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of specialist assistance; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of stress and caregiving; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of practical support; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of autonomy; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of specialist assistance; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
